Initial release: generate AI-powered 1080p cover images or thumbnails for videos and images, optimized for content creators.

- 15–30 second processing time; outputs ready-to-download 1080p MP4 covers.
- Session-based workflow allows iterative editing, previews, and exports.
- Built-in credit management and error handling for smooth user experience.
